claims.text: A WIP limit caps the number of items in a board column (WIP = work in progress); when the column is full, no new item is pulled into it until one leaves.
claims.source_hint: glossary wip-limit; The Kanban Guide (limiting WIP); docs/team/kanban-board-example.md:14-20

claims.text: docs/team/kanban-board-example.md@stage-1 lines 8-12: Đang làm (giới hạn 2) holds two items, Chờ review (giới hạn 2) holds one; lines 16-20: Dev 4 finished a task and wanted a third item, the team lead stopped them, and a full column is called a signal of blockage, not a free seat.
Limiting work in progress favours finishing over starting and makes a bottleneck visible as a column that stays full.
Try-it arithmetic: Đang làm 2/2, Chờ review 1/2; moving the review item to Xong leaves Chờ review 0/2; moving one Đang làm item to Chờ review leaves Đang làm 1/2 and Chờ review 2/2.
With many items open at once and a person's time split across them, each item takes longer to finish.
claims.source_hint: The Kanban Guide (controlling WIP helps flow); outline item 3
